tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i dpal 'byor nor bu las// gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad pa// dngos grub mchog stsol mgon po yi// lo rgyus rim pa 'bri bar bya// bla ma chen po mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad la dbang 'byor pa skye rgu rnams kyi yid kyi sa gzhir zab don gdams pa'i char rgyun gyis brlan par mdzad pa las/ thar pa chen po'i byang chub kyi myu gu 'thon pa/ nges par legs pa 'bras bu'i mchog dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po sku tshe 'di nyid du bde blag tu bskrun par mdzad pa las/ lha dang bcas pa'i skye bo thams cad kyi rnam par 'dren pa chen po/ lung dang man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes pa/ mkhas pa'i yang mkhas pa chen po/ thub pa'i dbang po dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po khyung po rnal 'byor zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po lta bur gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pas/ bla ma dam pa mai tri pa ko sa la bhik+ṣa'i dur khrod na bzhugs pa la gser srang nyis brgya phul nas/ bod longs spyod chung bas nor sgrub myur la rtags mtshan che ba zhig zhu byas pas/ bla ma mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mgon po zhes kyang bya/ shing phung can gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ tsan+dan gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya/ tshe 'di dang bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ dgra thams cad brlag par byed pa/ bzlog pas mi tshugs pa/ mchog dang thun mong lo'am zla ba tsam gyis 'grub pa/ mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar la 'byung ba cig yod gsungs/

de su la zhus byas pas/ sngon gyi dus na sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi spyan sngar thugs rje chen pos sems bskyed do// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di ma stongs kyi bar du bdag 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig gal te sems bskyed de nyams par gyur na/ mgo tshal pa stong du 'gas par gyur cig ces dam bcas te/ ri bo po ta lar nyin mtshan dus drug tu sems can rnams la ye shes kyi gzigs pas 'jug cing gang la gang 'dul gyi don byed par gyur to// de nas lo dpag tu med pa'am bskal pa'i bar du sems can gyi don byas pas sems can zad pa tsam du song las che snyam nas po ta la nas gzigs pas/ sems can gyi khams la 'phel 'grib med pa'i steng du snyigs mar song nas nyon mongs rags la gdug pa che bar song 'dug pas/ da ni bdag gis sems can 'ga' yang sgrol bar mi nus par 'dug snyam nas sems bskyed btang ba dang*/ dbu tshal pa stong du gas par gyur to// de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas byon nas rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i sems bskyed las gzhol ba ni ma legs kyi/ de'i bshags pa la sems bskyed de bas kyang rgya che ba zhig skyor cig gsungs nas dbu tshal pa stong du gas pa bcu gcig tu byin gyis brlabs so// de nas sngar gyi sems bskyed de las rgya che ba med cing*/ de'i cha tsam zhig las ma nus pas/ de las rgya che ba'i thabs ni ci'ang med snyam nas/ zhag bdun gi bar du brgyal bar gyur to// de nas brgyal ba de sangs pa dang*/ de ni snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung la bar chad mang bas rkyen dbang 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bas/ longs spyod chung ba/ 'tsho ba dman pa/ bsgrub long med par bar chad kyi dbang du 'gro ba/ dam tshig mi bsrung bar bzlog pa dang nang dme byed pa/ phal cher bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar bar gzigs nas/ yun ring bsgrubs mi dgos par zhal mthong ba/ gsol ba btab tsam gyis 'di phyi'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/

mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig gis brlag par byed pa/ mchog dang thun mong thams cad rtsol pas bsgrub na zla ba gcig 'byung ba'i dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i khro bor gyur nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam nas/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag 'thon pa las ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur gyur pa dang sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so// de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas/ rigs kyi bu sems can gyi re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i spyod pa 'di lta bu shin tu legs so// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba las byung ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed pos phrin las kyi nus mthu dang ldan par bya'o// gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro mas dbang gi rang bzhin gyi dbang dang ldan par bya'o// de nyid kyis zhi ba dang rgyas par yang 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las su dbang bskur ba'i sprul pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ srin po dang*/ ma mo rnams kyis kyang las sna tshogs sgrub par 'gyur ro// de nyid tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ dran pas kyang dngos grub ma lus thams cad ster bar 'gyur ro// ma bsgrubs pa nyid nas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid kyis dngos su zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de nas dpal shā ba ri pa zhes bya ba bram ze'i rigs su gyur pa/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang nye ba na grong khyer chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i dbus na tri pā la zhes bya bar rol mo mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur nas/ sngon sangs rgyas la glu dang rol mos mnyes par byas pa des/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi 'jag ma'i spyil po cig na sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs tsa na nam mkha' la ḍa ma ru dang*/

dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra chen po grags nas gzigs pas ye shes kyi mgon po 'di byon nas/ rigs kyi bu nga'i sgrub thabs 'di zungs shig gsungs nas shā ba ri pas sgrub thabs yi ger bkod do// ngas ni lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud dang man ngag rnams zhus dus su dpal phyag drug pa 'di gnang nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig nas zhal mthong ngo*// khyed kyis kyang dpal phyag drug pa 'di la nas rjen 'thag gi gtor ma dang spos sbyar mas mchod par gyis/ khyi nag la rdo ma rdeg yid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ de ltar byas pas sgrub gnas thams cad du 'tsho ba sbyor bar 'gyur ro// zhag bcu gsum gyis slob ma dang bcas pa la zhal dngos su bstan par byed do// dngos grub thams cad kyang tshul bzhin du ster bar byed do// zhes lung bstan nas bka' bsgos lan gsum mdzad do// byams brtse'i 'od stong 'khrigs pa na// mkhyen pa'i ye shes nam mkha' las// gdul bya 'dul ba'i skyes bu che// bla ma khyung po las brgyud pa'i// ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i// thugs bskyed lam gyi rim pa 'di// bris pa'i dge ba rgya chen des// bdag sogs sems can byang chub shog /sems can thams cad bde legs su gyur cig/ ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ a dhiṣ+ṭhā na ma hā kā la sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/

myur du 'byung ba'am/ nam mkha' la mgyogs par 'byon pas/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs kyis sna drangs nas 'byon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dril bu g.yer kha zhabs gdub dang bcas bgegs bi nā ya ka gdan byas mnan/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i brdar sku mdog nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ gyi steng na dar ljang gu'i ske rag byas pa/ /phyag drug klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yas pas nyon mongs pa gcod pa'i brdar gri gug bar pas sems can gyi don mi brjed pa'i brdar phreng ba 'dzin// tha mas chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i brdar ḍa ma ru ni gnod byed 'jigs par byed pa'i tshul gyis drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pas rnam rtog gcod pa'i brdar thod khrag dang ni dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i brdar mdung rtse gsum// de bzhin sems can 'khor ba nas 'dren pa'i brdar zhags pas bzung nas 'dzin par byed/ /shin tu 'jigs shing rngams pa'i drag po'i zhal las mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ sma ra ag tshom gyen du brjes pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum drag po'i dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'bar/ ba sbrul gyis bcings pa dpral bar sin+dhu ra 'am yang na mtshal gyis yis legs par byugs// spyi bor skra'i gseb na mi bskyod pa thugs ka yan chad gsal ba dbang bskur ba'i tshul de yis rab tu brgyan/ da ma tshig sems dpa' la ye shes sems dpa' brtan par bzhugs pa'i tshul du rtag par rang gi steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /dus rtag par shing gi kha la bzhugs te/ /shing las byon nas gtor ma len par dmigs/ la bsnyen sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā la rdo rje nag po chen po k+ṣīṃ sa bon k+ṣi tra pā la ste zhing sbyong bigh+rān bgegs ste gnod sbyin bi nā ya ka log 'dren te tshogs kyi bdag po hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsung rgyun la phaṭa phaṭa swā hā yod/ ces pa'i sngags 'di lan bdun brjod la gtor ma sbyin// byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs// slob dpon shā wa ris mdzad pa rdzogs so//

༈ /nag po chen gsung rgyun la pā la sbyar ba'ang mang po'i sgrub thabs sri'u gso ba'i las mtha' dang bcas pa bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ a dhiṣ+ṭhā na ma hā kā la sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan// nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can// phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yas pa gri gug bar pa phreng ba bsnams// tha ma ḍa ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pa thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum// de bzhin zhags pas bzung nas 'ching bar byed// drag po'i zhal las mche ba rnams par gtsigs// spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar// dpral bar sin+dhu ra yis legs par byugs// rin chen thod skam rigs lngas dbu la spras// spyi bor mi bskyod pa yi rgyas btab brtan/ pas na rdo rje rigs kyi lha yin/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhengs// shing las byon nas gtor ma len par dmigs/ /bsnyen pa'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣīṃ k+ṣe tra bi gh+nān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phrin las sgrub sngags/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣīṃ k+ṣe tra ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ru dhi ra māṃ sa hasta/ gṛ hi ta bhasmi ku ru hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ las sbyor sngags/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u ba ha ri nis e ṣo3pa sh+tsi ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tīdz+nyā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭa kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun brjod la gtor ma sbyin/

dpal ldan nag po che ba'i mchog /ye shes phyag drug bsgrub 'dod pa'i// rnal 'byor pa yis 'di ltar bya// dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas dag tu// dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi bya// 'thas par byas la chag chag gdab// thig gdab bsgo bzhi gru chad ldan// pho brang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi dgod// kha dog phyogs dang mthun par bya// sgo khyams nag po nang khyim dmar// gru chad smug po mu khyud mthing*// rtsibs mchan dkar po zhi bar bya// pho brang dbus su gta' gtor bca'// shar sgo rdo rje lhor gri gug /nub tu thod pa ltag sprod rnga// byang sgor rgyan gtor gzhag par bya// sha chen gri khrag dag gis brgyan// mgon po'i spros bsreg mar me gtams// bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni// ye shes lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom// dkyil 'khor pam̐ las pad 'dab brgyad// de steng ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil// de steng zla thog bgegs kyi rgyal// bi nā ya ka kha sbub 'gyel// de yi steng du hūm̐ nag po// de las 'od 'phros las bzhi bsgrub// tshur 'dus gri gug nag po yi// yu ba gser gyi rdo rjes mtshan// rno dbal thur la bltas pa'o// rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil// de steng hūm̐ yig nag pos mtshan// de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas// tshur 'dus pa las dam tshig pa'i// mgon po gzhung bzhin bsgom par bya// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskums bgegs chen gzir// rus pa'i zhabs gdub rgyal rigs glu// dkar khra'i sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o// stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// lto ba thur la 'phyangs pa la// thung zhing sbom rags gel pa'i gzugs// gnag cing gzi brjid che ba la// mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can// dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa'o// zhal bgrad mche gtsigs ljags dril zhing*// ag tshom ser nag sma ra can// shangs rdog che zhing khro gnyer bsdus// spyan dmar gru gsum sdang mig gzigs// dam la gnas pa'i rtags kyi mchog

/dpral bar sin+dhu ra dag gi// thig le 'bar bas mtshan pa'o// dbu skra kham nag gyen la brdzes// sangs rgyas rigs lngas mtshan pa yi// thod skam lnga bcus dbu la brgyan// dmangs rigs nag khra'i sbrul gyis bcings// mi bskyod pa yi rgyas gdab cing*// bram ze dmar khras mgrin pa snyan// rje rigs ser khras phyag gdub brgyan// g.yas kyi dang pos thod phreng 'dzin// bar pas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar// tha mas thod pa ltag sprod rnga// dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa'o// g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag gsol// bar pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsgrengs// tha mas rdo rje lcags sgrog gi// zhags pas dgra bgegs lus la 'debs// de yi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*// hūm̐ nag 'bar bas mtshan par bsam// 'od zer ḍa ma ru yi sgras// lho phyogs dur khrod bsil tshal gyi// tsan+dan sdong po'i steng dag nas// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bstim// thugs kar sa bon hūm̐ nag la// rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar blta// phub ral can dang gri gug bing*// dpal ldan lha mo la sogs pa'i// bka' sdod las mkhan phyogs bzhir 'khod// gang bcol phrin las bsgrubs par bsam// de nas bdag gis sngags bzlas pas// gtso bo'i thugs ka'i gsang ba'i sngags// gyen du byung ste zhal du 'thon// bdag gi zhal thim dngos grub thob// thugs ka nas thon thugs kar thim// thugs dam thugs rgyud mgal me yi// 'khor lo'i tshul gyis sngags bzlas pas// sngags las phrin las bzhi yi 'od// 'phros pas las bzhi byas par blta// de nas thun bzhir brjod bya zhing*// thun mtshams dag tu gtor ma bsngo// yi ge brgya pas nyams chag bskang*// ye shes mi gshegs snga sor gzhag /sems can don du bsngo ba bya// bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor gyis// za 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam bzhir// dus dang yi ge grangs dang ni// rtags rnams ma rdzogs bar du bzla// dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug

/yi ge bye ba phrag gnyis te// grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho gnyis// rtags ni sgrub la brtson pa yis// lus ngag yid gsum g.yeng ba spang*// dmigs pa rtse gcig gsal bar bzla// bya nag lding dang khyi nag 'khor// sngags pa chas gos nag po can// bran g.yog tshul du las byed cing*// zas nor ster ba rmi ba'o// de dag khro zhing rgyags pa dang*// bdag gi lad mo sna tshogs byed// mig log mchu dmigs byed pa rnams// las mgon khros pa'i rtags yin pas// gtor ma gtong zhing bshags pa bya// de la gtor ma'i man ngag ni// rin chen snod dang ka pā lar// 'bru sna gsum gyi zan gyis dgang*// gri sha gri khrag la sogs pa'i// rgyan gyis brgyan te chang gis bran// de nas sems bskyed yi dam bsgom// swa bhā wa yi sngags kyis ni// phyi nang snod bcud stong par bsam// skad cig tsam las snod kyi nang*// ram̐ las nyi dkyil de steng du// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga nyid kyi// sa bon gsal bar gyur pa dang*// 'og tu yam̐ dang ram̐ nyid las// yam̐ las rlung byung ram̐ las me// 'bar te yig 'bru zhu ba las// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'bru gsum brjod pas ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi dpag med 'phel bar bsam// de nas dam tshig mgron bskyed de// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas// bstims te phul bas mnyes par bsam// hūm̐/ bde gshegs bla ma mgon dang bcas// ye shes phyag drug gtso 'khor dang*// dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun// bstan bsrung phrin las bsgrub don du// rnal 'byor bdag gi gnas 'dir gshegs// gdung ba'i sems kyis spyan 'dren gyi// thugs dam thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// da lta nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā k+ṣīṃ/ zhes pa'i rtsa sngags lan bdun brjod// skar mda' lam du zhugs tshul gyis// gnas nas byon nas thim par bsam// hūm̐/ mnyam med mthu chen me ltar 'bar// dgra bgegs ma lus thal bar rlog

/thal byed gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i sku// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal// rtsa sngags bdun la ba liṃ gdags// gtso bo ye shes pa la dbul// las sngags bdun gyis 'khor lo dbul// bstod pa bya zhing phrin las bcol// de yi dus su spos bsregs te// btsan dug nyungs kar sgog skya gsum// gri khrag dang sbyar ril bu bya// yang na gu gul nag po dang*// btsan dug yungs kar bu ram rnams// gri sha dag dang sbyar byas te// ril bu sran ma tsam byas nas// sol ba'i me la bsreg par bya// lha rnams 'du zhing bgegs rnams skrag /de las dngos grub thob par 'gyur// 'di ni man ngag dam pa'o/ /de nas gso ba'i las bstan pa// 'khor lo tshe thag bla phur rnams// bsrung bya'i go khrab rdo rje yin// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud ldan/ k+ṣīṃ k+ṣetra/ /lte bar rtsa sngags bsrung bya'i ming*// mu khyud nang ma sgrub sngags te/ shrī badz+ra/ /phyi ma rten 'brel sngags kyis bskor// rtsibs la hūm̐ chen 'bar ba brgyad// rtsibs chen rnams la las sngags dgod/ shā sa na/ /mchod pa lnga bsham rab gnas bya// de nyid gang rung lus la gdags// bgegs kyis me phung 'bar bar mthong*// tshe yi thag pas bsrung ba ni// dar ram g.yang mo lug gi spu// legs par bkal te sum sgril bya// bsnyen sngags sgrub pa las sbyor sngags// stong rtsa gcig la sogs pa bzla// sngags de rdo rje lu gu rgyud// gser gyi kha dog 'bar ba las// yig 'bru thams cad 'khril bar bsam// mdud pa gsum la sku gsung thugs// bsgoms te rab tu gnas pa bya// gang bsrung lus la btags pa yis// rdo rje rwa ba'i nang zhugs pas// log 'dren bgegs kyis mthong mi 'gyur// bla yi phur pa bca' thabs ni// lcags sam seng ldeng smug po la// rab tsha khru gang yod pa las// rgya mdud gnyis dang gcum gzhog brgyad// dbal gsum rtse mo rno bar bya// sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru dgod// las sngags mgul du btags nas ni// nag po chen por mnga' gsol la// gang bsrung de yis sngas su gzug

/bgegs rnams dag cing 'byer bar 'gyur// gal te 'tshe zhing nyod gyur na// zab mo du ba 'phro gcod sngags// dri bzang sman gyis legs bris te// rab gnas tshul bzhin byas la gdags// zla gtor brgya rtsa ma chag gtong*// de yis khrag bcad bzhin du 'gro// oṃ na mo ma tri gha na se tsi'u tri'u tardza swā hā/ lhag chad med pa rab tu gces// tshar nas gtang rag dus su gtong*// ming nyid chos skyong mtha' can gdags// gdug pa can gyi gnod byed la// dang po glud dang gtor ma sbyin// tshad med bzhi yi ting 'dzin gyis// chos bshad bden pa bdar bar bya// las ngan dbang gis spogs gyur na// drag sngags me yi 'khor lo 'di// las sbyor sngags kyi sham bur gdags// dus bzhi dag tu gzir bar bya// oṃ rā ga ma hā rā ga ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ bh+ra ma ra kha swā hā/ pre ta pre sa tsa ra ri/ ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ a bhi sa ga mā ra ya/ rā ga sa phaṭa swā hā/ gdug pa 'jil byed sngags rgod 'di// shā wa ri ngas rab tu gsang*// las ngan can gyi sri can la// mnan pa'i las kyis gdul 'dod na// kham sa'i bum pa gsar pa gcig /sa dkar tshon gyis legs byugs te// rgyal bsen dkor bdag gang gnod pa'i// mtshan ma brtags la ling ga bca'// de yi snying gar yi ge tri// gri rgod g.yag pa'i khrag gis bri// ye shes lha yi nga rgyal dang*// phyag rgya bzhi yi sngags kyis bkug /lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyis// gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs nas// drangs te gnyis med bstim par bya// sgrub pa zhag gsum bar mi bcad// ling ga bum par bcug nas ni// de yi steng du dngul chu dang*// dngul thal zangs dang ra gan dang*// 'bras dang nas dang bra bo rnams// yongs su brngos te blug par bya// kham phor gsar pas kha bcad la// kha rgyan shu dag nag pos bya// lha khang mgon po'i zhabs 'og gam// mchod rten rnying pa'i 'og tu mnan// yang na rgya gram lam du'o// de yi gsang sngags bstan pa ni// oṃ ka mi ni rā dza swā hā/

ka ni rak+ṣa ni phaṭa/ s+t+waṃ bha ni phaṭa/ mo ha ni phaṭa/ dang po'i zhag tu chos skyong sngags// de nas man ngag 'di nyid bzla// gang gnod them bu bkag pa bzhin// 'gro 'gyur the tshom med pa yin// bsreg bya'i ling ga dpal 'bar la// mchod gtor dpal gtor zor gtor rnams// rim pa bzhin du gnas su gtong*// rten gsum bca' ba'i man ngag ni// sku rten lugs su blugs pa dang*// 'bur du gtod dang ris su bris// mtshan ldan bla mas rab gnas pa'i// gsung rten gsang sngags gser yig la// thugs rten bde gshegs gdung la bya// las kyi kā la'i rten dag ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra gcig /g.yul lam pha tshan nang dme yis// skad cig tsam gyis srog bcad pa'i// gri rgod chu krog ma reg pa'i// tsit+ta 'bar ba gcig la bya// srog rtsa dbu mar rang bsrel gzhug /g.yas su gsung rten gzhug par bya// g.yon du rin chen sna lnga dang*// dri bzang sman dang spos kyi dgang*// dar sna lnga yis dril byas te// rgyun par mchan khung g.yon par bcang*// sgrub pa'i dus su dal steng bzhugs// de yis lus dang grib ma bzhin// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par 'gyur// gso dang bsad pa rnam gnyis las// mchog tu gso ba'i las la shis// bsad pa'i las thabs gzhan du shes// rten gyi man ngag zab mo 'di// dmu rgod sems can gdul dka' rnams// chos 'dod slob dpon mi 'dod pas// gdams ngag thob nas bla ma spangs// dam nyams lag tu shor ba srid// snod med rnams la gsang bar bya// ༈ /sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug gsum du// rtags 'di dag la yid brtan bya// phyi rtags nang rtags gsang ba'i rtags// khros pa'i rtags dang bzhi ru bstan// phyi rtags bsnyen sgrub byed pa'i dus// dal las 'od dang me stag 'phro// sgrub khang thog 'tshegs bya rog lding*// mon pa nag po glu len cing*// dar nag thogs nas 'phyar ba 'ongs// nang rtags slob dpon chos 'chad cing*// gdugs phub seng khrir sdod pa dang*// pheb par smra dang lung ston dang*// bhan+dha mtshan ldan zas kyi snod// byed par rmi na lha nye'o// gsang rtags mgon po rmi lam dang*// dngos su zhal ston gri gug dang*// thod phreng cang te ka pā la// rtse gsum zhags pa ster ba dang*// stag seng mchong bar ston pa dang*// shel gyi mchod rten la 'dzegs shing*// de la bskor ba byed pa dang*// chos nor gter bton grub rtags so// a tsar nang 'khrugs byed pa dang*// ral gri'i char pa 'bebs pa dang*// bya nag lug nag 'bab pa dang*// bud med nag mo khro zhing brdeg

/mi sdug sna tshogs ston pa sogs// khros pa'i rtags yin bshags par bya// dam rdzas dpung bskyed bsnyen bsgrub la// brtson 'grus drag pos 'bad par bya// de ltar byas pas 'di 'grub ste// the tshom yid gnyis spang bar bya// chos skyong 'di yi khyad par ni// 'khor la mi gnod rbad sar 'gro// dkar dang nag mo klu bdud dang*// btsan dang the'u rang rgyal po sogs// dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par byed// nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal shā wa ri dbang phyug gis zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas mdzad pa man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs so// ༈ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas kyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang rgyas pa bar chad kun sel gyi phyag len bzhugs so// rgyal kun thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs// myur mdzad dbang gi rgyal por sku sprul nas// 'gro ba'i don sgrub brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag /chos srung ma hā kā las 'gro 'di skyongs// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i mgon po yi// byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'i khrigs// ma nor don tshang lag len bklag chog 'di// go bde'i ngag gis 'chad la bdag blo spro// de la 'dir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa lha mang gi rjes gnang gtor dbang bar chad kun sel du grags pa 'di/ snod ldan gyi slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla ma dang mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bris sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na dgram/ de'i mdun stegs bu'i khar rdul tshon gyis chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag re khā rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa/ mtha' me ri 'bar bas bskor ba zur gcig rang la bstan pa/ de'i dbus su gri gug mthing nag gi lte ba la hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa'am/ yang na hūm̐ yig rkyang pa bris pa'am tshon phung bkod kyang chog

de lta bu'i chos 'byung gi dbus su mañdzi'i khar gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum pa mtha' mtheb kyus bskor ba de la mda' rgod sgro ma dar nag gi cod pan can gzug mgon po'i tsakli yod na'ang gtor ma la 'dzugs pa phyag len yin/ chos 'byung gi g.yas su yi dam gtor ma dang*/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gtor ma gnyis zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba/ mdun du mgon po 'di nyid kyi 'bul gtor gru gsum mtheb kyus bskor ba/ gzhan yang chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang bcas pa/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ me tog phor bu 'brus bkang ba la sogs pa ma tshang ba med par bsham/ de nas slob dpon gyis kye rdor bde mchog gam spyan ras gzigs sam rta mgrin gsang sgrub la sogs pa 'di dang 'brel chags shing skabs su bab pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song ba'i mthar/ mdun gyi chos 'byung gtor ma dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal gyi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag me ri 'bar ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can rnams brtsegs pa'i steng hūm̐ las gri gug lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug gnyis pa na thod phreng*/ gsum pa na ḍa ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod khrag gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/

klu brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ glang po che'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig les byugs shing*/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag zhabs thams cad la rus pa'i phreng ba dang*/ dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs pa'i nang du bh+yo las 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa gri gug g.yon gyi dang po na rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pa na thod rlon khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la seng ge dang g.yon pa dug sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dmar la ser ba/ dbu la zla tshes dang rma bya'i mdongs kyis spras pa/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma 'char ba/ zhing chen dang glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing re lde'i sham thabs la sbrul nag gi ske rags bcings pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ma mo dang sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du k+ṣīṃ las gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ ral pa gyen du gzings shing spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ mgon po'i g.yas su dziṃ las dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas thod pa'i ḍa ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mgon po'i rgyab tu ṭām̐ las gshin rje ṭā ki rā dza sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse las me 'bar ba/ lha mo'i g.yon du hūm̐ las bdud mgon trag shad nag po/ g.yas ru mtshon dmar po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon tsan+dan gyi beng shing bsnams pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol zhing rta nag rting dkar la bcibs pa/ bzhi ka'ang rngams shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dmar la g.yo ba dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de dag gi phyi rol du phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu ste gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad gang ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ bdag mdun gnyis kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod tsan+dan gyi sdong po rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ dpal nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dril bu gsil zhing*/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la'i tshogs// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// k+ṣe tra pā la la sogs pa'i// 'khor gyi gnod sbyin bka' nyan tshogs// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye/ ma hā kā lī de wī yak+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed la bstim/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ ma hā kā la phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku// sku yi cha lugs mi bzad 'bar ba la// dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa'o// gsung gi nga ro mi bzad 'bar ba la// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra yis stong gsum khengs// rnam dag thugs ni mi bzad 'bar ba la// spros dang bral yang mtshan ma ci yang ston// sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas khyod la bstod// ces pas bstod la/ de nas yi dam gyi gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ yi dam gyi lha gang yin gyi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis dbul/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ lha rang rang gi bstod pas bstod/ mdun gyi chos skyong gi gtor ma la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣīṃ k+ṣe tra pa la bigh+nān bi nā ya ka e daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtso bo la dbul/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣīṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi nā ya ka rak+mo ba liṃ ta mā sa rak+ta ru dra kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis lha mo la dbul/ de nas chos skyong spyi'i sngags shā sa na lan gsum gyis gtso 'khor thams cad la dmigs nas thun mong du phul la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī/ 'khor gnod sbyin bzhi/

gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las dang stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtso bo la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣīṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nan bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa bgrang*/ lha mo la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra na rak+ṣīṃ k+ṣām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa grangs ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ 'khor gnod sbyin rnams la dmigs nas rim bzhin/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzī na mi tra wā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭā ki rā dza sa ma ya bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dud yag dza ma hā kā la trag shad hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa nyer gcig re bzla/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma bos la khrus byas/ phyag dang g.yon phul te gral la 'khod pa la/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos nyams su len snyam pa'i bsam pa drag po re bskyed mdzod/ de'ang dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa la bar chad sel bar byed pa'i srung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su bab pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gdul bya'i don du yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i srung ma'i dbang po'i skur sprul pa myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'di yin la/ 'di mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis rgya gar du mnga' bdag mai tri pa la gser srang bdun phul nas des bod rnams longs spyod chung ba yin pas nor sgrub mthu myur la rtags mtshan che ba zhig zhu byas pas/

mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mgon po zhes kyang bya/ mgon po shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya/ bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ mi nor zas gsum shugs la 'byung*/ dgra thams cad brlag par byed/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad lo zlas 'grub pa zhig yod pa de sbyin gsungs/ de bla mas su la gsan zhus pas/ mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ kho bos shā wa ri dbang phyug las thob/ shā wa ri pa de dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na sgrub pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i tshe nam mkha' la ḍa ma ru dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra chen po grags nas gzigs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di byon nas rigs kyi bu sgrub thabs 'di zungs shig gsungs nas shā wa ri pas sgrub thabs yi ger bkod par yang mdzad gsungs/ yang sngon gyi dus na dur khrod chen po mun pa mi zad pa zhes bya bar slob dpon dha na saṃ skṛ ta zhes bya bas ye shes kyi mgon po 'di mngon sum du gzigs/ 'khor gnod sbyin rnams kyis srog sngags phul nas las thams cad bsgrub par khas blangs pa'i bla ma des rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra la gnang*/ rā hu las bod du gdams ngag sgo skyel mdzad du byon nas khyung po la gnang*/ khyung po nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byung ba yin pas yid ches pa'i gnas su mdzad 'tshal/ de lta bu'i ye shes kyi mgon po'i rjes su gnang ba la sngon 'gro'i slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin/ dngos gzhi slob ma dang thun mong du bya ba'i rim pa la/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul nas sngon 'gro skyabs sems bya ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mkha' 'gro chos srung dang bcas pa mngon sum du zhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dang*/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha dang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug sems bskyed pa ni/ gong gi skyabs yul de rnams kyi spyan sngar yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug rjes gnang dngos la mdun du rten gsal btab cing ye shes pa spyan drangs pa/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa dang bzhi yod pa'i dang po ni/ mdun phyogs kyi chos 'byung gtor ma dang bcas pa'i gnas 'di nyid du ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa tsan+dan gyi nags tshal 'khrigs pa'i gzhir chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma tshogs kyi bdag po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes bya ba nas/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed kyi skabs kyi mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin brjod la/ 'di rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can zhes pa nas/ blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug yang slob dpon yi dam du gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi sku lus la phog pas tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i zhes pa nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i bar spyi dang 'dra/

stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes pa nas/ chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma nyi ma tshogs bdag gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing nag de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes pa nas/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ de thams cad kyi sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas slob dpon dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od dang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod kyi dbus/ shing tsan+dan gyi sdong po rkang gcig pa'i drung na mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog thugs rje dang thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran pas ye shes kyi mgon po de nyid thogs med du bzhengs nas byon pa la g.yas nas dpa' bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ g.yon nas dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo/ bka' nyan gyi gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba khro zhing 'khrugs la dges shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ 'ur 'ur thib thib byon nas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la dril gsil dang rol chen bya zhing*/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs su brjod pa'i spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa'i rjes su k+ṣīṃ nyer gcig dang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po de nyid ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'i myur mdzad kyi mgon po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang nges shes bskyed mdzod/ gnyis pa dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba ni/

khyed rang mgon por gsal ba dang mdun bskyed kyi mgon po gnyis char gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po re gsal la slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs lus la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ tshar gcig slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i dpral ba'i oṃ la phog pas mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ oṃ de las mgon po'i sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ khyed rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim ste 'od zer dkar po byung bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi dril bu gsil/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ badz+ra wī ra wī ra ṇi shrī ye/ badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ka dzo ki ni/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tsha mi kyai/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga'/ mthu stobs la thogs pa mi mnga'/ thugs rje la phyi shol mi mnga'/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas rdo rje'i slob ma 'di'am 'di rnams la zhes pa skabs dang sbyar la dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig

ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣīṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mang du brjod/ yang gsang dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ tshar gcig slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi mgon po'i mgrin pa'i āḥl phog thugs rgyud bskul/ āḥde las mgon po'i gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa sogs nas sngags brjod pa'i bar rigs 'gre/ yang gsol 'debs 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ tshar gcig yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la phog pa nas 'od zer sngon po 'phro 'du sogs dang*/ sngags brjod pa'i bar rigs 'gre/ yang 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ tshar gcig slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la phog pas/ yig 'bru gsum las de 'dra ba re byung nas khyed rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim/ yang khyed rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ mgrin pa'i āḥthugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas mgon po'i sku dang dbyer med du 'dres/ des kyang brtan g.yo 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas de thams cad 'od zer sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/

de nyid mtha' nas rim bzhin bsdus te dbus su nam mkha' la du ba yal ba ltar sngo yal song bas gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral bde ba chen po'i ngang du lus sems khong glod de ji tsam gnas kyi bar du 'jog par zhu/ slob dpon gyis dril bu gsil zhing*/ na mo bud+dhā ya zhes pa nas sngags brjod pa'i bar snga ma gsum dang 'dra/ gsum pa gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ mdun gyi gtor ma de nyid slob ma'i spyi bor spyan drangs la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas khyed rang gi spyi bor 'ur 'ur chem chem bzhugs pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' skor kun tu gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku las 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la thim pas sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag mgon po'i sku las mgon po'i sku chung la yan lag rags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas thogs med du zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang*/ sku dges pa'i gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyi sgra sgrogs shing nad gdon thams cad zhal du dmar 'ji ri ri gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar gsal ba'i bla ma dang mgon po rnam pa tha dad kyang ngo bo dbyer med pa la mos gus kyi shugs drag po bskyed la/ rgyas pa brgyud 'debs gnas sbyar ma dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ yang na sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs so// chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba 'debs so// dpal ldan shā wa ri dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang gis byin gyis rlobs shig de bzhin du mai tri pa nas bzung bla ma brgyud pa gsum re'i mthar bla ma mgon po dbyer med ces sogs sbyar/

mdor bsdu na/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// pha mtshan ldan gyi bla ma/ pha mtshan ldan gyi chos rje/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can la thugs rjes gzigs/ snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can la thugs rjes gzigs/ las ngan 'khor bar 'khyams la thugs rjes gzigs/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bka' bsgo ba dngos ni/ dpal ldan ma hā kā la/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo/ gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la/ gshin rje ṭā ki rā dza/ bdud mgon trag shad nag po/ ma gcig dus mtshan mkha' 'gro/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid kyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor lung rtogs yon tan la sogs pa legs tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gong gi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sngags kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams rim pa bzhin 'od du zhu nas mgon po 'khor bcas la thim/ 'khor rnams kyang gtso bo mgon po nyid la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams la brjod bral phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de'i ngang las ma g.yos par slar yang rang nyid snang stong dbyer med kyi mgon po'i skur gsal lam gyis gyur par mos pa mdzod/

bzhi pa sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ mgon po bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum byed du gzhug slob dpon gyis kyang mdun bskyed kyi mgon po la dmigs nas/ mgon po 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng rnams las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi rnam par byon/ so so'i zhal nas thon/ khyed rang mgon por gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig mthing nag cig bsams pa'i mthar g.yas skor gyis 'khod par bsams la 'di'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sogs mgon po'i srog sngags dang*/ shā sa na dang lha mo gnod sbyin bzhi'i sngags rnams rim bzhin lan gsum re slob dpon gyi phreng ba la 'jus te rjes zlos byed du gzhug des sngags thams cad kyi bzlas lung byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyis phreng ba'am me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang nus pa sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ da khyed rnams kyis 'di lta bu'i rjes su gnang ba thob nas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med du ltos la gsol ba thob/ nas nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang*/ spos sbyor rgyun ma chad par phul/ bya nag khyi nag sogs la rdo mi rgyag pa sogs bslab bya rnams la bslab par bya/ de ltar byas pas chos sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnyed sla zhing*/ mgon po 'di ngo bo spyan ras gzigs yin pas thugs rje gzhan las myur ba dang sgrub thag nye ba yin/

de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ gsum pa rjes ni/ thun gtor 'bul/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sogs dang*/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod par bya'o// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dpal shā wa ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ grub thob rā hu la gup+ta/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang*/ drin chen sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ yar tshar chen nas/ rje bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga ba chos kyi rgya mtsho/ des bdag la thugs brtse ba chen pos gnang ba lags so// de ltar myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang bar chad kun sel 'di ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos rgyas par mdzad pa la gzhi brten cing de ka bzhin 'dzol med gzhung bsrangs la/ 'on kyang las dang po pa la phan par bya ba'i phyir du tshig gi tshogs bskyungs te go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi chos grwar chu pho sprel lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i snyan brgyud zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/
